persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.
bank.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
bank.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
bank.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

messages.text: Could you create an ad for my fictional planning app DayNest, using simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green? I've been imagining how this little app might feel in an ad, and I'm a bit nervous about explaining the idea clearly. What I mean is that it should be silent, 9 seconds long in 16:9, with three equal-length scenes. The exact lines should be 'Less scrolling. More doing.' for the first scene, 'Plan your day in one place.' for the second, and 'Try DayNest today.' for the third, keeping the capitals and punctuation exactly as written. Please don't include any other visible words at all, even in the background.
